dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seen anyone around that looks a lot like me?

dialogues.speaker: Flagpole Cheng
dialogues.text: Oh... So you were looking for someone to talk you... You gave me a fright.

dialogues.speaker: Flagpole Cheng
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, someone did show up some time ago who had a very similar silhouette to yours...

dialogues.speaker: Flagpole Cheng
dialogues.text: ...But my glasses had already been broken before that. It's also possible that you passed this way earlier and I caught sight of you.

dialogues.speaker: Flagpole Cheng
dialogues.text: So, is the person I saw the one you're looking for? I don't know either...
